answer.reply: I lengthened the domino row from about 1 m to 1.9 m (10 → 14 growing dominoes) and swapped the 8-ball for a golf ball. To make room I slid the ledge and cup 89 cm right.

text: Kitchen version: swap the wrecking ball for a bowling ball on a rope, turn the brick tower into a stack of tissue boxes, and swap the tennis ball for an apple.

answer.reply: I swapped in a 7.26 kg bowling-ball-sized bob on an 80 cm rope, nine tissue boxes for the bricks and an apple for the tennis ball. The tissue boxes are 2.5 cm wider, so I moved the bucket 2 cm right.

patches.why: the wider tissue boxes would start inside the bucket

text: Make it a pirate-ship version using only wooden things.

answer.reply: I swapped the glass marble for a 1.6 cm wooden ball and made the cup wooden, so everything is wood now. The library has no pirate ship parts (hull, mast, sails), so those couldn't be added.

patches.why: Wooden ball at the marble's size so it still fits between the ramps
